quotes.speaker: Royce O'Neale
quotes.summary_phrase: Royce O'Neale on Hornets' overtime loss and missed opportunities
quotes.excerpt: you want to close out the game in the fourth quarter, but going to overtime still gives you a chance
quotes.quote: It was tough. You want to close out the game in the fourth quarter, but going to overtime still gives you a chance to fight in the game. Just a couple of missed possessions that we missed throughout turnovers and then trying to execute, but I think it's something we can learn from and we were right there.
quotes.social_post: Royce ONeale on the Hornets overtime loss to the Lakers: It was tough. You want to close out the game in the fourth quarter but we had a couple of missed possessions and turnovers.

structured.context: Royce O'Neale discusses the Hornets' overtime loss to the Lakers and the team's missed execution in the final moments.

quotes.speaker: Royce O'Neale
quotes.summary_phrase: Royce O'Neale on Hornets' depth and next-man-up mentality
quotes.excerpt: each game is going to be somebody different. Guys got to be ready when their number is called
quotes.quote: Each game is going to be somebody different. Guys got to be ready when their number is called, be ready to play. And I think every game, you don't know who it's going to be, so I think everybody just being prepared mentally, having an impact on the game whenever they get in, that's what's going to help us out down the long.
quotes.social_post: Royce ONeale on the Hornets rotation: Each game is going to be somebody different. Guys got to be ready when their number is called and have an impact on the game whenever they get in.

structured.context: Royce O'Neale explains the importance of the Hornets' bench players staying prepared and ready to contribute when called upon.

quotes.speaker: Royce O'Neale
quotes.summary_phrase: Royce O'Neale on Hornets' takeaways before final road trip game
quotes.excerpt: we did a lot of good things, a couple things we can learn from, just build on
quotes.quote: Just learn from this. We did a lot of good things, a couple things we can learn from, just build on. So continue to get better and then think about it, but be prepared for the next game.
quotes.social_post: Royce ONeale says the Hornets are focused on learning from their mistakes and building on the good things they did tonight as they prepare for the next game.

structured.context: Royce O'Neale reflects on the team's performance and the need to improve before the final game of their road trip.
